Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game VFX animation sprite sheet for AshBound, a grounded dark medieval hand-painted RPG with cutout 2D characters in a 3D world. Create ONE transparent RGBA square atlas, 1024 by 1024, EXACTLY four equally sized 512x512 cells in a clean 2x2 grid, WITHOUT visible grid lines. Each cell contains a successive animation frame of the SAME bare-fist HIT IMPACT effect, anchored precisely at the center of each cell. Reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right.
Art direction: spectacular hand-drawn cel animation, jagged ink silhouettes, energetic dry-brush tapering marks, warm ivory flash with small muted ochre fragments and fine charcoal accents. Sharp asymmetric starburst like air compressed by a strong fist, NOT an explosion of fire. Frame1 tight sharp initial star 35% cell width; frame2 peak broad broken starburst 75% cell width with 7-9 irregular tapered rays; frame3 opened hollow center with separated outward flying brush shards around 75% width; frame4 very sparse fading disconnected tapered streaks, wide hollow center. Center stays registered, no travel across cells. Strong readable silhouette at 128px. Each cell has at least 48 pixels fully transparent border; nothing crosses cells. Same scale, perspective and brush language. No characters, no fist drawing, no scene, no props, no ground shadow, no HUD, no lettering, no captions, no numbers, no border, no watermark. Actual alpha transparency: no black/white/checkerboard background painted into image, no opaque rectangular haze. Rich intentional painting rather than simple vector star. Thin controlled translucent edge only; no screen-filling bloom.
assets.windup: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D combat VFX sprite sheet for AshBound, a dark medieval hand-painted RPG. Create ONE square transparent RGBA atlas, EXACT 2x2 equal-cell grid, 4 sequential animation frames in reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Invisible grid. Effect anchored exactly at each cell center with generous fully transparent 12% cell border, no crossing gutters. Distinct hand-drawn cel-animation brushwork: warm ivory highlights, muted ochre accents, fine charcoal ink; sharp tapering shapes with a little dry-brush texture. Polished expressive animation effects readable when each cell is only 128px. Truly transparent background with preserved alpha; no black, white or checkerboard rectangle. No people, bodies, weapons, objects, scenery, ground shadow, text, letters, numbers, watermarks or UI. No fire, magic rune, neon lighting, fog rectangle, stone fragments, lens flares, excessive tiny noise. All four frames of one coherent effect, not four unrelated designs. An ANTICIPATION / WINDUP effect, restrained curved motion strokes gathering tightly around a fist before the strike. A partial tilted backward C-shaped hooked brush sweep with transparent center, direction is a coiling preparation, NOT an impact star or completed attack. Frame1 two thin dark ochre tapered short wisps, width35%; frame2 gathering three ivory-edged crescent strokes width45%; frame3 tighter brighter three strokes with a small sharp gold tip width50%; frame4 deliberate poised peak, sharp bright gold-ivory hooked accent with two tiny separated punctuation flecks width55%. Maintain centered registration. Absolutely no complete circles, shields, halos, electricity or radial explosion. This is the visual warning of an imminent punch and must be clearly different from a hit.
